messages:
Anya (PM): Thanks for the all‑hands — quick follow-ups from the Q&A about release cadence, oncall, quality bars, and SLAs. Can we get concrete owners and next steps?

Sam (CTO): Short version: moving to smaller, more frequent minor releases (biweekly) + quarterly majors. We'll do feature-flag-forward rollouts and stricter gating. Full plan + migration steps coming.

Maria (VP Eng): On quality/gating: every release must pass the CI perf/regression suite and have at least 2 code reviews for feature PRs. Flaky e2e tests get quarantined; owners must fix quarantined tests within 2 sprints or they get disabled from release gates. We'll add explicit pipeline checks.

Carmen (Product): SLA clarifications: hosted paid tiers keep 99.9% availability. Dedicated customers get 99.95% (contracted). Private installs depend on the customer contract + network topology. I'll update the public SLA doc and surface differences in the onboarding checklist.

ops-bot: deploy/canary job #478 passed for canary -> scheduled roll (duration: 12m). :white_check_mark:

Raj (SRE): Oncall specifics: primary rotates weekly, secondary rotates every two weeks. For sev1 infra incidents target MTTR < 30m, escalation path is primary -> secondary -> oncall manager. We'll add a 2-hour blackout window around major release cutovers and publish updated runbooks.

Lucas (Eng): For rollouts, what are the automatic rollback triggers? Error rate? Latency?

Maria (VP Eng): Rollback triggers we will standardize on:
```
rollback:
  - metric: 5xx_rate
    threshold: 0.01   # 1% 5xx over window
    duration: 300s
  - metric: p95_latency
    threshold_increase: 0.4  # 40% relative increase vs baseline
    duration: 300s
```
Automation will roll back and post the reason to the release channel. We'll put this into the rollout templates in the console.

Anya (PM): Great. Can we assign owners & deadlines so I can collect and run the follow-up sync?

Sam (CTO): Owners: I (Sam) will own the release cadence doc (draft by Mon Apr 6). Maria to land gating config in the pipeline by Apr 3. Raj to update runbooks and blackout policy by Apr 10. Carmen to publish the SLA clarifications by Apr 8. Lucas will help with QA automation for the perf/regression suite.

Carmen (Product): I'll also prepare a short customer-facing FAQ for Dedicated vs Hosted SLAs.

Raj (SRE): Adding: we'll add a weekly oncall shadow for the first month of the new cadence to smooth the transition.

Anya (PM): Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m sync with all owners for next Tue and post the agenda + doc links. Assignments noted. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled by Anya has been added to the calendar for Tue 10:00-10:30 (invite sent).
